90 PRINT:PRINT
100 INPUT"WHAT ARE THE VALUES OF A,B,&C IN AX[2 + BX + C";A,B,C
110 FORA1=ATO-(A)STEP-1*SGN(A)
115 IFA1=0THENNEXT
120 A2=A/A1
130 IFINT(A2)<>A2THENNEXT

150 C2=C/C1
